name: @bowenluo718/agent-lray
description: Web dashboard for viewing AI agent session logs — supports OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, OMP, DeepSeek Harness, and Gemini CLI

scripts.build:ui: node scripts/build-diagnostics.mjs && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:demo: node scripts/build-demo-fixtures.mjs && cd frontend && VITE_DEMO=1 npm run build
scripts.build:ui:full: cd frontend && npm ci && cd .. && npm run build:ui
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('frontend/dist/index.html')) { console.error('frontend/dist missing — run npm run build:ui:full'); process.exit(1); }"
